messages:
samir: Quick sync — prepping AWQ/GPTQ pass for mistral-7b-v2. Need signoff on calibration dataset size and tokenizer quirks before we run the batch quant tonight.
emily: What size are you proposing? and any special stratification?
samir: Thinking ~8k samples stratified by length, but see notes below. example config snippet:
```\ncalibration:\n  samples: 8000\n  bucket_strategy: uniform_len\n  long_tail_add: 2000\n  seed: 42\ntokenizer:\n  version: v1.2\n  pad_token: "<|pad|>"\n  truncate_strategy: tail\n``` 
jia: 8k is ok for median distro but we saw failure modes on long prompts in staging. recommend adding +2k long-tail (>=1024 tokens) and ensure dialog-style prompts included.
ken: heads up — tokenizer v1.3 changes unk handling (drops special markers). we should use v1.2 for this model to keep tokenization stable. weights + tokenizer paths:
- weights: s3://redwood-models/mistral-7b-v2/weights/v2/
- tokenizer: s3://redwood-models/mistral-7b-v2/tokenizer/v1.2/tokenizer.json
emily: what are the acceptance thresholds for AWQ/GPTQ? numbers pls.
samir: quick eval vs fp16 baseline (w/ heldout 2k prompts):
- fp16 ppl: 1.12
- awq 4-bit ppl: 1.18 (+0.06)
- awq rouge/qa f1: -0.4% relative
Our internal gate: ppl delta <= +0.10 AND task perf drop < 1.0% -> pass
jia: can you paste the eval command + seed so I can repro locally?
samir: eval command (run on a small canary):\n```bash\npython eval/run_eval.py --model s3://redwood-models/mistral-7b-v2/weights/v2/ --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/mistral-7b-v2/tokenizer/v1.2/tokenizer.json --calib-size 10000 --seed 42 --batch 8 --metrics ppl,qa_f1\n```\nI'll put a reproducible gist after the run.
ci-bot: CI: quant-canary pipeline queued for mistral-7b-v2 (canary-id: qc-2026-11-05-17). Logs will appear in <internal-ci>/runs/qc-2026-11-05-17
ariel: who has final signoff for Dedicated rollout? need to know before I schedule target capacity change.
emily: signoff owners: ML eng (emily/jia) for accuracy, Platform (ken) for tokenizer/weights path + infra. ops (ariel) for capacity scheduling. 
ken: I can approve infra once you bump calib to 10k and lock tokenizer to v1.2. also we need a short runbook note about fallback to fp16 if tail-case latency regresses.
samir: ok — will regen calibration set to 10k with the +2k long-tail strat and re-run AWQ canary tonight. will share gist + perf numbers and ping @emily @jia for accuracy signoff. :thumbsup:
emily: thanks — will review asap after you post results. :eyes:
jia: cheers, ping here when done.
